verdict.rationale: Probes confirm a live llms.txt (HTTP 200) and a docs.md index, and doc pages are served as .md. Bento also ships agent-oriented material: an AI agent setup journey, Bento Skills that tell agents which surface to use and carry safety guidance, and a ready-made prompt for AI agents. Missing for 10: evidence that llms.txt indexes the full docs rather than mostly listing marketing features, and independent user reports of agents consuming these docs successfully.
